summary: Join KLA's eBeam Division as a software developer to build high-quality solutions for our current and next-generation products, working on exciting problems that fuel technological advancements.
responsibilities: Build software solutions for our products with direct impact on semiconductor manufacturing leading to better quality of life
Work with exceptional talent across multiple global regions and functional groups
Develop end-to-end software from requirements to delivery, writing high-performing code and applying clean coding practices
Analyze current software systems for performance, throughput, diagnosis, and troubleshooting problems
Implement software in accordance with functional use cases ensuring high performance and optimized hardware interactions
Incorporate sophisticated software algorithms for resource-intensive software requirements to optimize performance
Good software documentation skills are required
required_skills: Master's or Bachelor's Level Degree in Computer Science or related field
2 to 3 years of related work experience
Ability to analyze problems and tackle them
benefits: Benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees
